name: OmaRGB
author: vonsensey
description: Every RGB device, wearing your theme. An OpenRGB-powered control center: live full-palette theme sync for keyboards, mice, coolers, RAM and cases, per-zone color roles, a real keyboard matrix view, lock and urgent reactive lighting, and a Doctor that diagnoses stubborn Arch RGB setups with copyable fixes.

barWidget.description: Device count and the color your rig is wearing. Click for the control room; right click toggles all lights.

schema.label: Follow the Omarchy theme
schema.description: Repaint every managed device from the theme palette the moment the theme changes.

schema.label: When the session locks
schema.description: Lights restore to their exact previous state on unlock.

schema.label: Flash on urgent window
schema.description: Pulse managed devices in the theme's urgent color when a window demands attention.
